item.title: claude-mem growth mechanics
item.value: claude-mem's 65k-star Feb 2026 explosion was a GitHub Trending velocity flywheel (+1474/+1730/+1930 stars on Feb 3/4/6), not a single launch post: weeks of pre-seeding (multiple HN posts Dec 2025-Jan 2026 incl. 'Show HN: Stop Claude Code from forgetting everything', hundreds of releases, docs site, plugin-marketplace + npx install) plus X aggregator pickup (@LiorOnAI). Implication: stack all launch channels into one 48h window to trip the trending threshold; the roundup-blog/AINews tail is then automatic.

item.title: Plugin marketplace mechanics (mid-2026)
item.value: Claude Code plugin distribution is self-serve: ship .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in a GitHub repo; users '/plugin marketplace add <repo>'. Official directory = anthropics/claude-plugins-official (browsable at claude.com/plugins); third parties can submit, light review, reserved/impersonating names blocked, Anthropic does not verify plugin behavior. Must be live before launch day; pair with an npx install path (both claude-mem and claude-flow prove npx matters).

item.title: vibe-kanban lesson: distribution != retention
item.value: vibe-kanban: solid Show HN (195pts/132c, July 2025; founder fixed telemetry-on-by-default within hours after thread backlash) but Bloop shut down 2026-04-10 ('vast majority free users, no business model'). Lessons for us: never ship default-on telemetry into an HN launch; the retention moat for a free OSS graph product is data gravity (memory graph compounds = switching cost); vibe-kanban's orphaned users are a targetable migration audience; track 'installs still emitting graph events at d30' as the retention KPI they never had.

item.title: Infra-OSS stars-to-usage conversion (Graphiti/Mem0)
item.value: Graphiti's growth driver is its MCP server (hundreds of thousands of weekly users per Zep's blog) — the integration surface, not the repo, is the channel; Zep also narrowed OSS to one repo for docs/community quality and recycles milestones as blog posts. Mem0 converts via default-provider slots (native CrewAI memory provider, LangChain, exclusive AWS Agent SDK memory provider; 13M PyPI downloads). Implication: ship our MCP server as a first-class distribution artifact and pursue default-slot integrations (Agent HQ / Cursor fleets).

item.title: Who covers Claude Code tooling + submission paths
item.value: X/media that covered claude-mem/agent tools: @LiorOnAI (aggregator that broke claude-mem), @swyx/Latent Space (AINews monitors 24 Discords + HN — front page = near-automatic mention), Theo (~500k YT), Fireship, @IndyDevDan (Mondays 8am CST, exact ICP for agentic workflows), @simonw (honest-evals fit), daily GitHub-trending roundup blogs. TLDR newsletter: submissions@tldr.tech (submit the data story, not the repo). awesome-claude-code (hesreallyhim): direct PRs forbidden — bot-only, use their automated recommendation flow. r/ClaudeAI (911k): build-story framing + 90/10 rule; r/ExperiencedDevs: do not post the tool.

item.title: Launch wedge: the null-result receipts post
item.value: The counter-position is unoccupied: claude-flow's benchmarks were caught fabricated, claude-mem's '95% token reduction' is unverified, nobody in the niche publishes nulls. THE launch asset = 'we measured when memory HURTS' post + raw-data benchmark page (we already hold a true ON-vs-OFF parity null) as the Show HN link, paired with a <=45s X clip showing task 2 inheriting task 1's summary then the live graph dashboard. Hold the held-out memory-win protocol for week 2-4 (the null is the first story, the win is the sequel).
